name: Rastovaca
description: A tiny cluster of guesthouses and family rooms right by Entrance 1, closest to the lower lakes and the towering Veliki Slap. Rastovaca is convenient for early park starts and photography, with a scattering of restaurants but very few other services beyond lodging.
bestFor: Early risers who want the lower lakes at their doorstep
pros: Walking distance to Entrance 1 and Veliki Slap
cons: Can feel busy with day visitors

name: Mukinje
tagline: The main guesthouse village near Entrance 2
description: A residential village just south of Entrance 2 and the most popular base for longer stays, packed with apartments, rooms and family-run guesthouses. Mukinje offers a genuine local feel, self-catering kitchens and a quiet setting, making it the practical choice for a slow remote-work stay.
bestFor: Slow-stay nomads wanting an apartment base
pros: Widest choice of apartments and rooms
Close to Entrance 2 and park shuttles
cons: Almost no nightlife or cafe scene

name: Jezerce
tagline: A peaceful hamlet by the upper lakes
description: A small, tranquil village neighboring Mukinje near Entrance 2, with a handful of guesthouses and holiday homes tucked among the trees. Jezerce is even quieter than its neighbor, ideal if you want forest calm and easy park access without any crowds around your lodging.
cons: No real services on the doorstep

name: Korenica
tagline: The nearest proper town for services
description: The largest town near the park, about fifteen minutes south, Korenica has supermarkets, a pharmacy, banks, fuel and a wider choice of restaurants. It makes a practical, affordable base for anyone wanting real amenities and a short drive to the lakes each day.
bestFor: Longer stays needing shops and services
cons: A short drive from the park
